revenue_growth.source: Assumption: fades from ~4% toward GDP-like growth; FY23-25 revenue CAGR was 6.5% (partly acquisitions), so a more conservative organic rate is used.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY2025 margin was 21.7% (8127/37442), FY2024 22.1%; hold ~22%.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: US federal statutory 21%; no effective rate computed from filings.

wacc.source: Assumption: CAPM cost of equity = 10Y UST 4.86% (2026-11-06) + beta ~1.1 (assumed, not looked up) x US ERP 4.46% (Damodaran 2026-02-16) = ~9.8%; after-tax cost of debt ~4.5% assumed; debt weight ~20% -> ~8.5%.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: below the 4.86% risk-free rate and in line with long-run nominal GDP growth.

net_debt.source: financial_statements derived net_debt = total debt 34,580 - cash 12,487 - ST investments 443, acc. 0000773840-26-000013
